title: PERSISTENT CAMP IDENTITY WARDROBE
description: The patch turns a design concern into a calendar decision and calls that production maturity. Player camps now preserve trophies, naming, and small visual scars from completed seasonal events. Outfits now include prestige variants, matching effects, and a bundle preview that understands insecurity.
consequence: The base started looking like a home instead of a storage error with rugs. Self-expression gained tiers, timers, and a receipt.

title: PERSISTENT CAMP IDENTITY COOLDOWN
description: The feature asks players to perform progress for each other before asking whether the progress is good. Player camps now preserve trophies, naming, and small visual scars from completed seasonal events. Limited-time labels and countdown nudges have been softened across the event shop.
consequence: The base started looking like a home instead of a storage error with rugs. Players felt less hunted. The dashboard noticed immediately.

title: CLEAN SLATE SEASONING WARDROBE
description: The release frames the feature as seasonal structure, while burying the real priority in the reward cadence. Old progression hooks have been flattened so returning players can experience the new season from a more equal baseline. Outfits now include prestige variants, matching effects, and a bundle preview that understands insecurity.
consequence: Everyone started together, especially the people who had already finished. Self-expression gained tiers, timers, and a receipt.
